description:
Functional specifications/files: add cold expired-person OAuth resolution with real persisted token_url and refresh HTTP rejection, plus natural near-future API-key expiry timer integration through ServerManager and OpenAIStub.
Tests first: expired personal OAuth + valid org never reaches LLM or falls back; exact refresh/config error; scheduled expiry stops matching runtime, then cold resolution rejects and makes no request; retain stale callback test separately.
Branches: expired OAuth refresh failure, optional no fallback, scheduled timer identity, expired cold start.
Mocking: external OAuth and LLM HTTP only; no production clock hook/private timer injection for scheduled case.
Docs: distinguish scheduler timing from deterministic callback coverage.
Action reuse: not applicable — tests reuse resolver refresh, ServerManager expiry and existing edge stubs.
title: Expired OAuth refresh and scheduled authentication expiry integration
